quotes.quote: The extra baseline quota with Anti-gravity could be worth it.
quotes.excerpt: I've heard that folks using using a mid-tier Anthropic model like Sonnet 5.5 easily run into limits. When I use GitHub Copilot (for work) with Anthropic models I can easily rack up quite a significant bill. This is why I'm comparing value for the money. While Google may not have the "best" models, what's the point if you hit a wall with Claude Code? The extra baseline quota with Anti-gravity could be worth it.
